_meta.purpose: Verified, speciality-tagged full product ranges. Supplements supplier-seed.json; never replaces it.

_meta.coverage: 9 suppliers expanded, 2,435 products in total, as at 12/08/2026. Read from the company's own product taxonomy (richest — real category tree): GBUK Group, Hospital Services Limited, Vygon (UK). Read from the company's XML sitemap (names derived from URL slugs, no category, and see each record's captureCaveat): Canon Medical Systems, ICU Medical (incl. Smiths Medical), Mindray UK, Mölnlycke, Steris, Terumo UK. medi UK was withdrawn on 12/08/2026: 146 of its 175 captured products sat in a single "Uncategorised" bucket, which the sitemap flatness bar refuses, and a re-crawl on that date refused it. It falls back to its curated seed product list; extended 18/08/2026 with a 23-company pilot batch prioritising framework/award-holding companies (crawl + independent adversarial verification pass; 10 of 23 accepted, 13 refused/rejected - see refusedOnReading for the notable ones): Agilent Technologies UK, D.P. Medical Systems Limited, Drive DeVilbiss Healthcare UK, GE HealthCare, Labcold, Laborie Medical Technologies UK Ltd, Lisclare, MIP UK, Storz Medical UK, Xiel Ltd.

refusedOnReading.medi UK: 84% of its 173 URLs carried no division segment — caught by the new majority-Uncategorised guard, which did not exist when this was captured.
refusedOnReading.Canon Medical Systems: Read by hand and refused: the 'divisions' are product-line codes (Aice, Alphenix, Ai, 'Mobiles Relocatables 2') rather than a product taxonomy, and entries like 'Experience', 'Deep Learning Reconstruction' and 'Interventional Radiology Oncology' are page titles, not products. No numeric test separates this from Steris or Mindray, which are fine, so this is a human judgement and is recorded as one.
refusedOnReading.Terumo UK: Read by hand and refused: its two main 'divisions' are 'Product Types' and 'Medical Field', which are the site's FACET names rather than divisions, and 'Cardiovascular' is listed as a product. Same judgement as Canon.
refusedOnReading.Eckert & Ziegler BEBIG: 18/08/2026: the UK legal entity (ECKERT & ZIEGLER BEBIG LIMITED, 05270457) was dissolved 05/03/2024; its former lines split between two other brands (medical.ezag.com, bebigmedical.com), neither confirmed as this entity's UK site. Refused rather than guessing a successor catalogue. FLAG: this company may need review as a live Hub supplier/award-holder given the dissolution.
refusedOnReading.Stryker (pilot re-check): 18/08/2026: an independent adversarial re-check of the initial capture found ~68% of the claimed division/product structure rested on URL patterns (/{division}/products/...) that do not exist in the actual sitemap - the real sitemap has single landing pages for those areas, not enumerable product lists. Only the smaller divisions (ENT, Acute Care, Craniomaxillofacial, Emergency Care, Communications, Foot & Ankle) checked out. Withheld pending a genuine re-crawl of those pages.
refusedOnReading.Heidelberg Engineering (pilot re-check): 18/08/2026: initial capture invented four ANTERION app names not present on the company's own page; the real four are Cataract App, Cornea App, Metrics App, Imaging App. Withheld pending a corrected re-read; the SPECTRALIS module list and the top two-division structure were independently confirmed genuine.
refusedOnReading.Thermo Fisher Scientific UK: 18/08/2026: sitemap product URLs are pure catalogue/SKU codes with no division segment at all; the only alternative structure on-site is a 'Brands' list, which is a facet, not a taxonomy. Refused.
refusedOnReading.Alpha Laboratories: 18/08/2026: genuine own-site taxonomy exists, but the sitemap it must be read from is stale - a stratified live-check found roughly two-thirds of sampled product URLs 404, one division at 0%. Refused on data-currency grounds pending a live-status crawl.
refusedOnReading.Hamilton Medical UK: 18/08/2026: sitemap carries only 2 product URLs; the site's own product taxonomy page rendered 'no products found' for the company's flagship ventilator line (a JS-rendering artefact, not a true absence). Refused rather than publish a structure known to be missing its most important branch.
refusedOnReading.Agito Medical A/S: 18/08/2026: ~94.5% of the catalogue is spare parts sitting in one flat 'Imaging Parts' bucket with no modality subcategory, despite each page's own description text naming a modality - clears the majority-Uncategorised guard by a wide margin. Refused; a smaller imaging-systems-only entry (434 items, genuinely categorised) would be a separate, achievable capture if wanted.
refusedOnReading.Hillrom UK (re-checked): 18/08/2026: hillrom.co.uk now redirects wholesale to hillrom.baxter.eu, which returns 403 and explicitly disallows AI crawlers in robots.txt (content-signal ai-train=no). Confirms the existing refusal; no change needed.
refusedOnReading.Bayer: 18/08/2026: every path on bayer.co.uk / pro.bayer.co.uk returned an explicit WAF block ('rated as harmful activity') to both curl and WebFetch. Refused - a manual browser session would be needed to get past this.

GBUK Group.notSold: Verified ABSENT from GBUK's current range: tourniquets, capillary/microcollection. Do not list these. Tourniquets confirmed CURRENTLY not a GBUK product by Lou directly (20/07/2026) — she ran this division. Supersedes the earlier web-research finding, which had this as an open question (GBUK Enteral is a named supplier on the NHSSC 'Blood Draw Tools and Accessories' framework, whose Lot 2 covers tourniquets, which read as ambiguous evidence of a possible off-catalogue product). Confirmed: no such product exists. Framework award ≠ product currently sold — a supplier can be eligible to supply a lot without stocking it.
GBUK Group.tubesNote: GBUK's blood collection TUBE range is described in an accordion on the category page, not as individual product records, so it does not appear as separate rows: no additive, coagulation, serum clot activator, serum gel & clot activator, DNA stabilisation, heparin, glucose, glucose with gel, EDTA, ACD anticoagulant, sedimentation systems, thrombin, thrombin with gel, plus urine collection systems. Latex/phthalate/DEHP free. Historic brand name 'Vacusense+' is UNVERIFIED -- every such URL now 404s.
